clown.definition:
n. a rude or vulgar fool
n. a person who amuses others by ridiculous behavior
v. act as or like a clown

clownage.definition: n. Behavior or manners of a clown; clownery.
clownage.translation: n. 小丑的行为或工作

clowned.definition: v act as or like a clown
clowned.translation: v. 扮小丑（clown的过去式与过去分词形式）

clownery.translation: n. 滑稽, 丑角表演

clownfishes.translation: (clownfish 的复数) n. 小丑鱼；海葵鱼

clowning.definition:
n acting like a clown or buffoon
n a comic incident or series of incidents
v act as or like a clown

clownishness.definition:
n. The manners of a clown; coarseness or rudeness of
   behavior.
clownishness.translation: n. 小丑；乡下人；粗鲁笨拙的人 (clown的变形)

clownism.translation: [医] 丑态(歇斯底里性怪异动作)

clowns.definition:
n a rude or vulgar fool
n a person who amuses others by ridiculous behavior
v act as or like a clown
clowns.translation: n. 丑角( clown的名词复数 ); 行为荒诞滑稽的人; 蠢货; 笨蛋
